statements.statement: A citizens' petition for a Proposition 2.5 override will be on the annual town meeting warrant.
The House Ways and Means budget recommends funding Chapter 70 higher than last year while level-funding unrestricted government aid.
With the latest House budget release, Lunenburg is now budgeted to receive a net increase in state aid over what was previously planned.
The school committee discussed seeking free cash at town meeting, with most of it going toward replenishing staff.
This year's town meeting will consider an omnibus budget of roughly this size.
Town meeting will also consider a municipal building project warrant article of roughly this size.
Town meeting will also consider a Marshall Park plan warrant article of roughly this size.
